{{Quote|Diamonds, pilot. They have diamond cores. Inside each of these miserable space rocks beats a pristine gemstone heart.|Captain [[Koh (Twi'lek)|Koh]]|<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>}}
'''Diamond asteroids''' were unusual [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] that contained large quantities of [[Diamond/Legends|diamonds]]. They were hard and dangerous to [[Mining/Legends|mine]].

The [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessa system]] was known to contain diamond asteroids.
